description: This source file contains unit tests for Orleans grain call filtering mechanisms, including filters, interception, context propagation, exception handling, and integration with streaming. It also defines several interfaces and classes used in test scenarios to verify filter behaviors.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterTests
classes.description: A comprehensive test suite for Orleans grain call filter interception, ordering, exception handling, dependency injection, and streaming interactions.
